name: can-loopback-routing-suite
description: Verifies the routing time of a gateway DUT that relays can0<->can1 on real hardware: payload integrity, routing time (each Frame's own server-side timestamp_ns, rx minus tx -- pure gateway API, no raw sockets), and no drops -- using can0/can1 wired onto one shared physical bus as a DUT-free stand-in. A methodology check, not a performance benchmark -- the default 5ms bound is deliberately loose.

tests.name: can0->can1 routing: payload, routing time, no drops
tests.description: 100 sequence-tagged frames injected via the gateway's FrameService.SendFrame on can0, observed via FrameService.SubscribeFrames on both can0 and can1; routing time is each frame's own timestamp_ns on can1 minus on can0.
